roles_en: President of the parliament of the Republic of Armenia
bio_en: Avetik Sahakian, known as Hayr Abraham ('Father Abraham'), was a veteran ARF leader. He was vice-chairman of the Armenian National Council and spoke at the opening session of the parliament of the Republic of Armenia in 1918, and he led the parliament during the Republic. In November 1917 he travelled from Van to Tiflis lamenting that Vaspurakan could not be held with the forces available; in Persia he insisted that the Armenians should be listed as Armenian, not as British subjects. He lived his last years in Iran with his wife Varvara Sahakian and died in 1933.
